lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section, with an increased gap distance between the final three lines on the posterior torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line segments 1, 4, and 5 (counting anterior to posterior) are truncated and terminate before reaching the ventral boundary of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two distinct high-contrast spots visible on the lower haunch/upper hind limb; one primary larger spot and one secondary smaller spot positioned inferior to the first.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white patch on the lower throat, a vertical white streak on the cheek below the eye, and two white spots visible on the muzzle.
